title: Container Shipping Faces 2027 Pressure as Huge Orderbook Hits the Water
key_claim: BIMCO expects fleet capacity to grow 4.6% in 2026 and 9% in 2027, with more than 14 million TEU on order (about 42% of the fleet), 2027 demand growth of 0.5% to 4.5% depending on Hormuz, and ship demand about 10% lower once Suez routings fully normalise.
frame_summary: Relays BIMCO's warning that the orderbook plus Suez normalisation weakens the 2027 container market: a supply-side argument for falling rates.
verbatim_quote: BIMCO now expects fleet capacity to grow 4.6% in 2026 and another 9% in 2027.

Once routings are fully normalized, ship demand could be about 10% lower

title: Xeneta Weekly Ocean Container Shipping Market Update, October 2, 2026
key_claim: On 1 October 2026 Far East-US West Coast spot rates stood at USD 8,346 per FEU and US East Coast at USD 11,523, up 344% and 335% on the 28 February pre-crisis baseline; Xeneta expects a correction to USD 4,500-5,500 and USD 6,000-7,000 but says rates will not collapse.
